examples.english: Even the same word can have different meanings depending on the region.

notes:
{異|こと}なる means to differ or vary—a formal/written alternative to ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {異|こと}なる

REGISTER:
- ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: to be different (everyday speech)
- {異|こと}なる: to differ (formal, written, academic)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{異|こと}なる: A differs from B
- ～⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{異|こと}なる: varies depending on ~
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異|こと}なり: unlike ~, differing from ~

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{異文化|いぶんか}→異文化：15703_ibunka⟧: different culture
- ⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧: abnormal
- ⟦{異議|いぎ}→異議：13552_igi⟧: objection
- ⟦{相違|そうい}→相違：04043_soui⟧: difference (formal noun)

USAGE:
Often used in academic writing, news, and formal contexts where ⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧ would sound too casual.

ASPECT (ている):
- {異|こと}なっている: is different / differs (stative)
- Note: {異|こと}なる is a stative verb describing an inherent difference, so the ている form (when used) simply emphasizes the current state of being different. More commonly, the plain form is used in noun-modifying position: {異|こと}なる⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧ ("differing opinions") rather than {異|こと}なっている⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧.
